QuestInfo.name: [New Year's Event] New Year's Greetings
QuestInfo.0: It's the New Year's Event! Wee Moon Bunny thinks that sending new years greetings is a good way to keep in touch. Talk to him to learn how to exchange greetings with your Maple family and friends and win awesome prizes!
QuestInfo.1:
Wee Moon Bunny says Maple families can exchange greetings to receive #e#bFamily Points (FP)#k#n. Collect Family Points every day and earn special prizes! 
(Remember, you get more points for sending greetings to players with a different family label.)
#e<How to Gain Family Points (FP)>#n
1) Right-click characters you want to exchange greetings with.
2) #rSelect 'Send Greeting'#k.
3) You receive Family Points (FP) when the recipient accepts the greeting.

0.0: Hey, #b#h0##k!\r\nHappy new year! What, you haven't sent a New-Years' greeting to your family?! I send greetings to all my family members back on the moon, along with some celebratory carrot juice! The postage alone costs me a fortune.
0.1: We #eWee Moon Bunnies#n wish Maple World were full of warmth, love, and tasty carrots! I'm doing my best to show the world we're all one big family. The least you could do is pitch in a little for your home planet.
0.2: Now, collecting #e#bMaple Family Points(FP)#k#n is easy.\nAll you need to do is send a greeting to someone with a #r#efamily label#n#k. What's a #r#efamily label#k#n, you ask? It's a generational title such as #e"Senior", "Mom", or "Uncle"#n, representing how many years you've spent in Maple World.
0.3: You can send up to #r10 greetings each day#k, but only to characters with the family label icons. You can, however, accept as many greetings as you like!
0.4: Confused? Well, it's easier to learn by doing. Find a Mapler with a family label, and send them a greeting! Pro tip: Greetings sent to characters with a different family label than your own will net you more #e#bFamily Points#n#k.

yes.0: #i3800594#\nFirst, find a character that has a #efamily#n symbol by their name. \n#eRight-click#n it and select #r#e'Send Holiday Greetings'#k#n from the menu!
yes.1: #i3800595#\nA message will be sent to that character! When they accept it, a special greeting window will open up.
yes.2: Whether you're sending the greeting or receiving it, you'll get Maple Family Points (FP) when it's accepted using the \n#e[Accept Greeting] button#n!\n#i3800596#
yes.3:
Now, there are a few restrictions. Listen carefully!

#e#b<Restrictions>
#k#n
1. You can only send one greeting to each character.
2. You can send up to 10 greetings each day.
3. You get more #e#bFamily Points#n#k when you greet characters with a different family label than your own.
yes.4: Look around for anyone with a family label, and send them a New-Year's greeting. You may end up brightening their day. Now hop to it!

no.0: You should make new friends by sending a New-Year's greeting to another character! Don't be discouraged if they don't all accept your greeting though. Not everybody is a fan of the holidays.

1.0: Good job! Not so hard, right?\r\nCollect as many #e#bFamily Points (FP)#n#k as you can! You'll get special gifts when at 1000 points, and at 1200 points. If you manage to reach 10,000 points, I'll give you a very \nspecial #b#eDamage Skin#n#k that you can only find on the moon!
